t.1310-58-3.agn: The pure substance is in the highest corrosivity category (Skin Corr. 1A); the statement on the label depends on its concentration in the product.
t.1310-58-3.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 019-002-00-8 (CLP00): Acute Tox. 4 (Oral)*, Skin Corr. 1A.
t.1310-58-3.what: Dissolves grease and raises the product's pH; used to make liquid soap.
